_comment: Local stand-in for the Edge Config item deals_digest (store paulchs-deals). Only used when EDGE_CONFIG is not set, and only in review mode. Copied from the 2026-10-12 Deal Intake Screener log.
intro: Two Charleston-area rentals made the cut this week out of 22 I looked at. Both are new listings in North Charleston, and both only work if the condition checks out.
assumptions: 25% down at 7.0% on a 30-year loan (1–4 units). Vacancy 5% for houses and 7% for multifamily. Taxes estimated at 0.8% of price. Rents marked estimated come from active MLS rental comps.

deals.unit_mix: 3 one-bedroom units, plus a 1,388 sf rear building
deals.headline: A triplex at about $110K a door, with a rear building that isn't counted in these numbers.
deals.upside: The 1,388 sf rear building could add income. None of it is included here.
deals.watch: Vacant and built in 1968, so rehab cost is the big unknown. Rents are estimated. Flood zone not confirmed.

deals.headline: A 3-bed house at $170K that cash flows at the asking price on estimated rent.
deals.upside: Low entry price for a first rental.
deals.watch: Built in 1956 and condition is unknown. Rent is estimated from a nearby comp.
